{{Short description|Vietnamese festival}}
{{Expand Vietnamese|Festival Huế|date=November 2023}}

[[File:Festival_Huế_2008-14.JPG|right|thumb|250x250px| Procession to the [[Sacrifice to Heaven]]]]

'''Festival Huế''' is a festival that has been held in [[Huế]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Hue festival |url=https://thuathienhue.gov.vn/en-us/Home/General-Information/Administrative-Organization/tid/Hue-festival/newsid/6DACD3EA-A599-4080-9922-AAC700E3CE98/cid/F3FC67A8-E858-468B-9DBE-A854010AD469 |access-date=2023-10-30 |website=Thua Thien Hue Portal - Beta |language=en-US}}</ref> every two years since 1992.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Hue Festival |url=https://www.vietnamonline.com/destination/hue/culture/hue-festival.html |access-date=2023-03-11 |website=www.vietnamonline.com}}</ref> Since 2002, it has included a [[Sacrifice to Heaven]] known by the Vietnamese name [[Nam Giao]]<ref name="nuoc-2017a">{{Cite web |last=nước |first=Cục Văn thư và Lưu trữ nhà |date=2017-07-02 |title=Giới thiệu "Nam giao Đại giá đồ thức" năm Bảo Đại thứ 20 (1945) |url=https://luutru.gov.vn/gioi-thieu-“nam-giao-dai-gia-do-thuc”-nam-bao-dai-thu-20-(1945)-136-vtlt.htm |access-date=2023-02-21 |website=VTLT}}</ref> which happens at the [[Esplanade of Sacrifice to the Heaven and Earth]].

== History ==
The first Hue Festival was held in 1992. It was named the '''Vietnam-France Festival''' until 2000, when the name was changed to Festival Huế.
